title: Plant Manager
text:
With a legacy spanning over 35 years, Harris Spice has been a trusted partner and leading supplier of high-quality spices, herbs, and innovative seasoning blends. With international facilities and a global supply chain, we proudly serve multiple channels of trade—including industrial bulk, food service, and retail. Our commitment to excellence, quality and consistency has earned us the trust of some of the nation’s largest and most recognized brands. As Harris Spice continues to grow, we are dedicated to cultivating a dynamic, inclusive workplace where innovation thrives. We're looking for diverse, talented individuals who are ready to grow with us and help strengthen a brand known for trust, quality, and bold flavor solutions.

**Position Overview/Job Summary:**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership and performance of the manufacturing facility, overseeing Production and Maintenance, and Planning & Scheduling as assigned. This role ensures safe, efficient, and cost-effective operations while meeting production targets, customer demand, quality standards, and food safety requirements. The Plant Manager drives operational excellence, equipment reliability, continuous improvement, and cost control while developing a strong, accountable team to achieve the company's business objectives.

**Essential Job Functions:**

· Provide overall leadership and direction for plant operations to achieve production, quality, safety, service, and financial objectives.

· Oversee Production and Maintenance, and Planning & Scheduling as assigned.

· Establish departmental goals, KPIs, and performance expectations aligned with company objectives.

· Ensure adequate staffing, equipment, materials, and resources to meet operational demands.

· Monitor plant performance, address operational challenges, and drive improvements in productivity, efficiency, and capacity.

· Ensure effective coordination between departments and hold managers and supervisors accountable for results.

· Oversee production activities to ensure products are manufactured safely, on schedule, within quality standards, and at standard cost.

· Monitor production performance, labor efficiency, material usage, waste, downtime, and OEE.

· Analyze production reports and KPIs to identify performance gaps and implement corrective actions.

· Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase productivity, improve yields, reduce waste, and optimize manufacturing processes.

· Ensure compliance with established SOPs and operational standards.

· Oversee Maintenance to ensure equipment, facilities, and infrastructure are properly maintained and operational.

· Establish and monitor preventive and predictive maintenance programs to minimize downtime and improve equipment reliability.

· Coordinate maintenance activities with production schedules to minimize operational disruptions.

· Monitor maintenance expenses, repair costs, and equipment performance.

· Implement equipment improvements, capital projects, and cost reduction initiatives.

· Oversee production planning and scheduling to align customer demand with production capacity, labor availability, and raw material inventory.

· Ensure production schedules are achievable and effectively communicated across departments.

· Coordinate with Supply Chain, Purchasing, and Customer Service to ensure material availability and minimize scheduling disruptions.

· Monitor schedule attainment and implement improvements to production flow and planning efficiency.

· Manage plant operating expenses and departmental budgets to achieve established financial targets.

· Identify opportunities to reduce manufacturing costs, improve labor utilization, and minimize material waste.

· Monitor plant KPIs, including production output, labor efficiency, OEE, downtime, waste, quality, and maintenance costs.

· Review departmental scorecards and performance reports to identify trends, address variances, and drive operational improvements.

· Ensure facility compliance with food safety regulations, GMPs, HACCP requirements, and company quality standards.

· Partner with Quality Assurance to maintain food safety programs and ensure consistent product quality.

· Ensure employees follow established SOPs, allergen controls, and food safety procedures.

· Support internal and external audits and ensure timely resolution of findings and corrective actions.

· Promote a culture of food safety and quality throughout the facility.

· Promote a proactive safety culture through hazard identification, employee training, incident prevention, and accountability.

· Lead, develop, and coach department managers and supervisors to achieve operational goals.

· Partner with Human Resources on staffing, recruitment, employee development, and succession planning.

· Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, communication, and continuous improvement throughout the facility.

· Other duties as assigned.

· This job description describes some of the main duties, activities, and responsibilities for the role, which may change at any time with or without prior notice.

**Skills/Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, Food Science, or related field preferred.
* 10+ years of manufacturing management experience, preferably in food manufacturing or high-speed automated operations.
* Minimum 7 years of experience managing multiple departments, managers, and/or supervisors.
* Strong knowledge of production operations, maintenance systems, equipment reliability, and plant management.
* Proven ability to improve productivity, reduce costs, manage budgets, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience with manufacturing KPIs, including OEE, labor efficiency, downtime, waste, and production yield.
* Strong understanding of food safety systems, including GMP, HACCP, BRC, or SQF, and OSHA requirements.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and ERP/MRP systems.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to lead teams, manage competing priorities, and drive accountability and results.
* Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.

**Physical Requirements**

· Ability to stand and walk throughout the facility for extended periods, including 8–10-hour shifts as operationally required.

· Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. and climb ladders when necessary.

· Ability to work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to heat, noise, and food processing equipment.

· Frequent walking, standing, bending, twisting, stooping, grasping, climbing, reaching, and moving throughout the facility.

· Will be required to work around spices and meat ingredients as part of daily activities.

Pay: $120,000.00 - $155,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
